snippet.title: Room 808 - Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist it on steam!!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641740/Room_808/

Join the discord to stay updated!! https://discord.gg/sdn5Kyya

Room 808 is a surreal horror game where you wander endless hotel halls in search of your room. Something feels off. Spot the anomalies, and try to get to your room before the hotel halls trap you forever.

You just want to get to your room, but something isn't right about this hotel. The hallway stretches on forever. The doors repeat. The lighting feels off. Something watches from the corner of your eye. In Room 808, nothing is quite as it seems. Your goal is simple: reach your room. The challenge? Spotting the anomalies...
